title: How Much Fresh Data Should CTR Recalibration Use? A Temporal Evaluation of Post-hoc Calibration
abstract: arXiv:2610.33168v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Offline evaluation of click-through rate (CTR) models still defaults to random splits, although deployed models score future traffic and downstream systems consume calibrated probabilities. On Avazu (40.4M impressions) we train logistic regression (LR), DeepFM, and DCN-v2 under two rolling temporal origins and a random split, three seeds per arm, and recalibrate each test day with Platt scaling and isotonic regression fitted on the preceding hours. At origin 1's nearest test day, random splits report LR's expected calibration error (ECE) at 55-62% of the temporal value in every seed (the deep models' ratio is seed-unstable), and no model's ECE is monotone in temporal distance. With a 6-hour fitting slice, recalibration removes up to 61% of ECE in badly miscalibrated cells but increases it in about a third of applications (14-17 of 48 across seeds). On fixed evaluation sets, a 12-hour slice cuts harm from 13-17 to 3-5 of 36 applications

translated_title: CTR重新校准应该使用多少新鲜数据？事后校准的时序评估
translated_abstract: 点击率（CTR）模型的离线评估仍然默认使用随机划分，尽管部署的模型需要对未来流量进行评分，且下游系统消费的是校准后的概率。在Avazu数据集（4040万次曝光）上，我们在两个滚动时间起点和一个随机划分下训练逻辑回归（LR）、DeepFM和DCN-v2，每组设置三个随机种子，并使用基于前几小时数据拟合的Platt缩放和等渗回归对每个测试日进行重新校准。在起点1最近的测试日，随机划分报告的LR期望校准误差（ECE）在每个种子中均为时序数值的55-62%（深度模型的比率在不同种子间不稳定），且没有任何模型的ECE随时间距离呈单调变化。使用6小时的拟合数据片段，重新校准在严重校准不良的情况下最多可消除61%的ECE，但在约三分之一的情形中反而增加了ECE（跨种子统计为48个情形中的14-17个）。在固定评估集上，12小时的数据片段将有害情形从36个中的13-17个减少到3-5个。
tldr: 该研究通过时序评估发现随机划分会显著低估CTR模型的校准误差，并证明使用12小时新鲜数据重新校准可将校准性能恶化的情形从36个中的13-17个降至3-5个，为事后校准的数据量选择提供了实证依据。
